description: Iterative-PP-A\* is a simple anytime search for two objectives. It runs PP-A\* from the start for each tolerance `ε` of a schedule, such as `0.01, 0.001, 0.0001, 0`. After each run, the solutions cover every Pareto-optimal cost within the factor `1 + ε` in both objectives; a schedule that ends with `0` ends with the exact front. It reuses nothing between runs, so it does more work than A-BOA\*ε, which is why it serves as the baseline in the A-BOA\*ε paper. Before the last run the solutions are not always Pareto-optimal, because PP-A\* returns representative paths.

papers.authors: Han Zhang, Oren Salzman, T. K. Satish Kumar, Ariel Felner, Carlos Hernández Ulloa, Sven Koenig
papers.title: Anytime Approximate Bi-Objective Search
